# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.64

- **Hardware tutorial (A.I.D.M.I.A.), second edition of the source work:** two new sections in all eight languages: the Open Camera settings for the burst (shutter, 10 s repeat interval, 200 repeats, 1:1 aspect, DRO, continuous focus, remote-control keys) and the finishing and publishing chain with PDF24 (page size, page numbers, watermark, annotation, premium and online copies). Photographs of people and pages of the books in the source are not reproduced.
- The tutorial now says that LegatorOCR is under the MIT licence (commercial use allowed).
